# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our standard

Participation should be respectful, technical, and constructive. Contributors and maintainers are expected to communicate in good faith, focus criticism on ideas/evidence/code, and respect different levels of experience and background.

Acceptable behavior includes actionable review feedback, acknowledging mistakes, respecting boundaries, and keeping technical disagreements evidence-based.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, intimidation, doxxing, sexualized attention, or repeated disruption.

## Scope

This applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, review comments, project-related communication, and public spaces where someone is representing the project.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to `i.am@dangkhoa.dev`. Reports will be handled as confidentially as practical. Maintainers may edit/remove content, warn participants, restrict participation, or ban accounts when necessary.

Retaliation against a person who reports a concern in good faith is not acceptable.
